# Lifetime Challenge: Build objects and furnishings in Workshops and C.A.M.P.s

__Build decorative furnishings in Workshops and C.A.M.P.s__

Tier 1 - 76 Objects Built

Tier 2 - 760 Objects Built

Tier 3 - 7600 Objects Built

**What counts towards this challenge:**

Anything on the below Build Menu Tabs

- Appliances
- Chairs
- Floor Decor
- Displays
- Shelves
- Tables
- Wall Decor

**Does building on a custom server count toward this challenge?**

Only building on Adventure - Public and Adventure - Private servers will count towards this challenge.
